app.name: Serverless Authenticated API Starter
app.one_liner: A production-ready serverless API starter kit using Node.js, TypeScript, Webpack, DynamoDB, and Auth0 for JWT-based authentication.

screens.name: API Gateway Interface
screens.purpose: Serve as the entry point for authenticated RESTful requests to the serverless backend.
primary_actions: Submit authenticated CRUD requests to DynamoDB-backed resources

rust_commands.name: save_item
rust_commands.purpose: Store a new item in the DynamoDB table after validating the user's Auth0 JWT token.

mvp_plan: week 1: Configure Auth0 JWT validation middleware for all endpoints
week 1: Implement basic CRUD operations for DynamoDB items
week 1: Set up local development environment with serverless-offline and serverless-dynamodb-local
acceptance_tests: API returns 401 when request lacks valid Auth0 JWT token
Authenticated user can create and retrieve their own items from DynamoDB
